current_explanation: Current website property requests for properties you can manage. Contact actions are read-only; the authorized team manages status and assignment.
buyer_explanation: Property requests linked to your signed-in account. Anonymous requests are not automatically claimed by matching an email address.
current_error: Inquiries could not be loaded. This does not mean you have no inquiries.
current_empty: No current inquiries match this view.
empty_page: This page is empty. Return to the previous page or refresh.
buyer_empty: No property requests are linked to this account yet.
open_definition: Open means new, assigned, scheduled or contacted. Closed inquiries are excluded from the open count.
no_contact_action: No valid contact action is available.
history_explanation: These older records come from the previous inquiry system. They remain separate and read-only, have no current lead status, and are excluded from current totals. No records are copied, merged or resent.
history_empty: No previous inquiries are available to this account.
history_error: Previous inquiry history could not be loaded. Try again to check it.
unknown_explanation: {{count}} inquiries have an unrecognized status. They appear in All, rather than Open or Closed.
admin_scope: Admin view: these inquiry counts and records cover all properties, including properties owned by other accounts.
